notes.title: ASPHALT RUSH is already available on Google Play!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31708889/097a7839b4a866e82e2f7847ee48b5b778d0d0c3.png[/img]

An extreme race along endless and varied tracks, full of dangers and surprises awaits you!

Collect a huge collection of legendary cars and compete with friends and other players!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31708889/f8a919fe61ee4f9ca14c62581c8168224efeb718.png[/img]

Complete unique and interesting challenges in Career Mode and upgrade your cars to become a cool racer!

Start playing now and become the first in the list of the best!

Google Play: [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.MagnoliaArt.HachiRoku]Download[/url]
